First off, my dog ​​loves it when I suggest going grooming.

I’ve had such a great experience with Pet Joy! Everyone is always so friendly and you can tell they genuinely care about the dogs. They’re gentle, patient, and always do an amazing job with the grooming. My dog comes home looking adorable, clean, and happy every time.

I’m very picky about who I trust with my dog, so I’m really glad I found this place. Definitely recommend Pet Joy to anyone looking for a groomer who truly cares about their pets. We’ll definitely be back!

PetJoy is such a gem! 🐶❤️

I recently moved to LA and had been searching for a groomer nearby. Unfortunately, our first experience at another place was pretty awful! Our pups were there for over 6 hours, came home looking uncomfortable, and their haircuts were… not great. 😔

Then we found PetJoy, and I’m SO glad we did! The owner is incredibly friendly and welcoming, and even gave us a treat pack as a new customer. Most importantly, they treated our two little pups with so much care and patience. 🥹

Our dogs are basically little balls of anxiety (as you’d expect from two tiny white crusty dogs 😂), so I really appreciated how well they were handled. Both pups were finished within just a couple of hours and came out looking absolutely adorable!

We’re so happy to have found such a wonderful groomer so close to home. We’ll definitely be coming back! Highly recommend PetJoy!

I had a wonderful experience bringing my dog Toby here for grooming. The staff was friendly, professional, and clearly cared about my pup’s comfort. My dog came home looking amazing, smelling fresh, and seemed relaxed throughout the entire process. The groomers paid attention to the details and followed my requests perfectly. I highly recommend this place to anyone looking for quality grooming services.
Gigi's first summer cut and PetJoy in LA did not disappoint.  I definitely recommend taking your fur baby to them.

Lovey had a wonderful grooming experience! When I picked him up, he looked fantastic. The groomer did an excellent job and paid close attention to every detail. What stood out most was how comfortable and happy Lovey seemed afterward. It's clear that he was treated with patience, kindness, and genuine care throughout the appointment. Knowing that he enjoys his visits gives me great confidence in the service. I highly recommend this grooming business.

I rarely leave negative reviews, but after giving Pet Joy a second chance, I feel other pet owners deserve to know about our experience.

Several months ago, we brought our small dog in for grooming and she came home with multiple shaving cuts and nicks across her skin. The injuries were serious enough that we had to take her to the veterinarian, resulting in both unnecessary pain for our dog and a significant vet bill for us. We were extremely disappointed but ultimately decided to move forward and give Pet Joy another opportunity, believing that mistakes can happen and hoping our experience was an isolated incident.

Unfortunately, that decision proved to be a mistake.

After scheduling another grooming appointment and making arrangements around their availability, we received a text message less than 24 hours before our appointment stating that they would no longer groom our dogs because they are "hard to manage." This came after they had already accepted the booking and with virtually no notice for us to find alternative care.

What is most frustrating is the complete lack of accountability. Our dog was injured during a previous grooming appointment, requiring veterinary treatment, yet rather than addressing that history professionally, they simply chose to refuse service at the last minute. If they felt our dogs were not a good fit for their business, that should have been communicated upfront before accepting the appointment—not the day before.

As dog owners, we understand that some pets require additional patience and care. That is precisely why we pay professionals for grooming services. We expect honesty, competence, and basic professionalism. Instead, we experienced an injured dog, unexpected veterinary expenses, and ultimately a last-minute cancellation after giving them a second chance they frankly did not earn.

We will never be returning, and I would strongly encourage other pet owners—especially those with small dogs or dogs that may require extra handling—to carefully consider whether this is the right grooming provider for their pets.
Thank you so much! We’re happy to hear you found our pricing reasonable and truly appreciate your support. Hope to see you again soon!

This is honestly the best grooming shop in LA! More than anything, the owner is incredibly attentive and truly cares about each dog.
From the moment we walked in, we were warmly welcomed. They approached my dog gently, making sure he felt comfortable and not startled, and took the time to consult with us carefully.
If you have a double-coated dog like mine, I highly recommend the Asian Fusion styling cut. It was absolutely worth it—no regrets at all. Seriously, don’t waste your money going anywhere else.
The texture and shape of the fur were handled so beautifully—every detail was on point, and I couldn’t be happier with the result.
I was also really touched by how thoughtful they were with first-time customers.
We’ve been searching for the right grooming shop for our dog for so long, and I can confidently say we’ve finally found our place. We’ll definitely be coming back!

They renovated the whole place and it looks clean and cozy. To be honest,  you can't get this level of service and care, including free snack bar and drink, from other places for what they charge.  I highly recommend this place.

Pet Joy has truly become a second home for my dogs, Roy and Tory. They’ve been going since they were puppies, and the warmth there still feels like a mother’s embrace. With the recent remodel, the space feels even more comforting and beautiful.

Everyone treats the dogs with such genuine care that I never worry for a moment. Roy and Tory run in with excitement every time and that says everything.

The prices are fair, and ever since the new owner (who has been grooming there for years) took over, the whole atmosphere has become cleaner, more luxurious, and better organized—without losing the heart!

I once stepped into the back area to use a bathroom and was amazed at how spotless everything was, from the bathing stations to the resting spaces. No wonder my pups always come home fresh, happy, and smelling wonderful.

Truly, the best grooming shop in the neighborhood!

We absolutely love this place. They’ve been taking care of Dobby and Otis for a long time now, and it truly feels like a second home for our boys. The team is always flexible, patient, and so gentle — especially with Dobby, who’s an anxious little guy and not the easiest to win over.

We also love that (from what we understand) it’s a Korean family-owned business — the warmth, consistency, and attention to detail really shows in how they treat every dog that walks through the door.

Every time we drop them off, we know they’re in good hands. It’s rare to find groomers you can fully trust, but they’ve earned it over and over again. The boys always come back happy, calm, and looking adorable. We’re really grateful for the way they care for them like family.

Highly recommend to anyone who wants their pups treated with real love and attention.
